.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/crea.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to scaffold the function, where <id> is the function's identifier (converted to camelCase for the file name and function name).

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/list.instruction: Run {{script}} [search term] to list all functions, optionally filtering to those whose file content contains the given search term.

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/upda.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> <change-request> to verify the function identified by `<id>` exists before continuing the update action.

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/dele.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to delete the function file corresponding to the given id.
Run {{script}} <id> to print, in `file:line` format, every existing reference to the function derived from `<id>`.

.gstudio/artifacts/function/scripts/eval.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> from the project root, where `<id>` is the function's id (e.g. `my-function`).

create.text: Scaffolds a new function file at src/src/functions/{name}.function.ts with a minimal function definition, given an id and optional initial content.

list.text: Lists functions defined in the codebase matching an optional search term, printing each as [id]: [file path].

update.text: Updates an existing function artifact's source file to satisfy a natural-language change request, given its id, erroring if the function doesn't exist.

delete.text: Deletes a function artifact by id, removing its file and cleaning up any dangling references to it across the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that a function artifact's file location, single top-level shape, and single-responsibility scope comply with the rules, given the function's id, printing pass or itemized rule violations.
